INVOKES: file system tools (read/write customization files), ask-questions tool (interview user for requirements), subagents for codebase exploration. """
Shared test fixtures for the Michelin Capstone backend tests.

Uses an in-memory SQLite database so production data is never touched.
"""

import os
import sys

# Ensure the backend package root is on sys.path so bare imports like
# ``from config import …`` work the same way they do when running the app.
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))

# Provide a default SECRET_KEY for tests so config import does not fail
os.environ.setdefault("SECRET_KEY", "test-secret-key")

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from sqlalchemy.pool import StaticPool

from database.database import Base, get_db
from database.models import User, AuditLog, APIUsage, IDMSData, BlacklistedToken

"""
Authentication router - Handles login, logout, and token management
"""

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request, status
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from database.database import get_db
from schemas.auth import LoginRequest, LoginResponse, TokenRefreshRequest, TokenValidationResponse
from schemas.user import UserResponse
from services.auth_service import (
    authenticate_user,
    blacklist_token,
    create_access_token,
    get_current_user,
    verify_token,
    oauth2_scheme,
)
from services.audit_service import log_login, log_logout
from database.models import User
from config import ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES

from datetime import timedelta

router = APIRouter()


@router.post("/login", response_model=LoginResponse)
async def login(body: LoginRequest, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """Authenticate user and return access token"""
    user = authenticate_user(db, body.username, body.password)
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Invalid username or password",
            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
        )

    access_token = create_access_token(
        data={"sub": str(user.id), "username": user.username},
        expires_delta=timedelta(minutes=ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES),
    )

    # Audit log
    log_login(
        db,
        user_id=user.id,
        ip_address=request.client.host if request.client else "unknown",
        user_agent=request.headers.get("user-agent", "unknown"),
    )

    return LoginResponse(
        access_token=access_token,
        token_type="bearer",
        expires_in=ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES * 60,
        user_id=user.id,
        username=user.username,
        name=user.name,
    )


@router.post("/logout")
async def logout(
    request: Request,
    token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    """Logout user, blacklist token, and log the action"""
    blacklist_token(db, token)
    log_logout(
        db,
        user_id=current_user.id,
        ip_address=request.client.host if request.client else "unknown",
        user_agent=request.headers.get("user-agent", "unknown"),
    )
    return {"message": "Successfully logged out"}


@router.post("/refresh", response_model=LoginResponse)
async def refresh_token(
    body: TokenRefreshRequest,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    """Refresh access token using existing token"""
    from services.auth_service import is_token_blacklisted
    payload = verify_token(body.refresh_token)

    if is_token_blacklisted(db, body.refresh_token):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Token has been revoked")

    user_id = int(payload.get("sub"))
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.id == user_id).first()
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Invalid token")

    # Blacklist the old token and issue a new one
    blacklist_token(db, body.refresh_token)

    new_token = create_access_token(
        data={"sub": str(user.id), "username": user.username},
        expires_delta=timedelta(minutes=ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES),
    )
    return LoginResponse(
        access_token=new_token,
        token_type="bearer",
        expires_in=ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES * 60,
        user_id=user.id,
        username=user.username,
        name=user.name,
    )


@router.get("/validate", response_model=TokenValidationResponse)
async def validate_token_endpoint(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):

from tests.conftest import TestingSessionLocal
from database.models import IDMSData, APIUsage


def _seed_idms(n=3):
    """Insert sample IDMS rows."""
    session = TestingSessionLocal()
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        session.add(
            IDMSData(
                asset_id=f"AST-{1000 + i}",
                site=f"Site {i}",
                equipment_type="Pump",
                status="Active",
                last_service_date=date(2026, 1, min(i, 28)),
            )
        )
    session.commit()
    session.close()


def _seed_api_usage(pages=("auth", "dashboard", "settings"), count_each=2):
    session = TestingSessionLocal()
    for page in pages:
        for _ in range(count_each):
            session.add(APIUsage(
                endpoint=f"/api/{page}/test",
                method="GET",
                page=page,
                response_status=200,
                response_time_ms=10,
                timestamp=datetime.utcnow(),

    session.commit()
    session.close()

"""
Authentication service - Business logic for authentication
"""

from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from typing import Optional
import uuid

from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from passlib.context import CryptContext
from jose import JWTError, jwt

from config import SECRET_KEY, ALGORITHM, ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES
from database.database import get_db
from database.models import User, BlacklistedToken

# Password hashing context
pwd_context = CryptContext(schemes=["bcrypt"], deprecated="auto")

# OAuth2 scheme for extracting bearer token from Authorization header
oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="/api/auth/login")


def verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str) -> bool:
    """Verify a plain password against a hashed password"""
    return pwd_context.verify(plain_password, hashed_password)


def get_password_hash(password: str) -> str:
    """Hash a plain password"""
    return pwd_context.hash(password)


def authenticate_user(db: Session, username: str, password: str) -> Optional[User]:
    """
    Authenticate user with username and password.
    Returns user object if successful, None otherwise.
    """
    user = get_user_by_username(db, username)
    if not user:
        return None
    if not verify_password(password, user.hashed_password):
        return None
    return user


def create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None) -> str:
    """Create a new JWT access token"""
    to_encode = data.copy()
    # Keep UTC semantics while storing a naive datetime for JWT compatibility.
    expire = datetime.now(UTC).replace(tzinfo=None) + (
        expires_delta or timedelta(minutes=ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
    )
    to_encode.update({"exp": expire, "jti": uuid.uuid4().hex})
    return jwt.encode(to_encode, SECRET_KEY, algorithm=ALGORITHM)


def verify_token(token: str) -> dict:
    """
    Verify and decode a JWT token.
    Returns payload dict if valid, raises HTTPException otherwise.
    """
    credentials_exception = HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
        detail="Could not validate credentials",
        headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
    )
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(token, SECRET_KEY, algorithms=[ALGORITHM])
        user_id: int = payload.get("sub")
        if user_id is None:
            raise credentials_exception
        return payload
    except JWTError:
        raise credentials_exception


def is_token_blacklisted(db: Session, token: str) -> bool:
    """Check whether a token has been blacklisted (e.g. after logout)."""
    return db.query(BlacklistedToken).filter(BlacklistedToken.token == token).first() is not None


def blacklist_token(db: Session, token: str) -> None:
    """Add a token to the blacklist so it can no longer be used."""
    # Reuse verify_token to ensure consistent JWT error handling
    payload = verify_token(token)
    expires_at = datetime.fromtimestamp(payload["exp"], UTC).replace(tzinfo=None)
    entry = BlacklistedToken(token=token, expires_at=expires_at)
    db.add(entry)
    db.commit()


def get_current_user(
    token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
) -> User:
    """FastAPI dependency: get the current authenticated user from the JWT."""
    payload = verify_token(token)

    # Reject blacklisted tokens
    if is_token_blacklisted(db, token):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Token has been revoked",
            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
        )

    user_id_str = payload.get("sub")
    try:
        user_id = int(user_id_str)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Could not validate credentials",
            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
        )

    user = get_user_by_id(db, user_id)
    if user is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="User not found",
            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
        )
    return user


def get_user_by_username(db: Session, username: str) -> Optional[User]:
    """Get user by username"""
    return db.query(User).filter(User.username == username).first()


def get_user_by_id(db: Session, user_id: int) -> Optional[User]:
    """Get user by ID"""
    return db.query(User).filter(User.id == user_id).first()

"""
Audit service - Business logic for audit logging
"""

import json
import math
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Optional, List

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from database.models import AuditLog, User


def create_audit_log(
    db: Session,
    user_id: int,
    action: str,
    description: Optional[str] = None,
    details: Optional[str] = None,
    ip_address: Optional[str] = None,
    user_agent: Optional[str] = None
) -> AuditLog:
    """Create a new audit log entry"""
    audit_log = AuditLog(
        user_id=user_id,
        action=action,
        description=description,
        details=details,
        ip_address=ip_address,
        user_agent=user_agent,
        timestamp=datetime.now(UTC).replace(tzinfo=None),
    )
    db.add(audit_log)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(audit_log)
    return audit_log


def get_audit_logs(
    db: Session,
    user_id: Optional[int] = None,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20
) -> dict:
    """Get paginated audit log entries, newest first."""
    query = db.query(AuditLog)
    if user_id is not None:
        query = query.filter(AuditLog.user_id == user_id)

    total = query.count()
    total_pages = max(1, math.ceil(total / page_size))

    logs = (
        query
        .order_by(AuditLog.timestamp.desc())
        .offset((page - 1) * page_size)
        .limit(page_size)
        .all()
    )

    return {
        "data": logs,
        "total": total,
        "page": page,
        "page_size": page_size,
        "total_pages": total_pages,
    }


def get_audit_log_by_id(db: Session, log_id: int) -> Optional[AuditLog]:
    """Get a specific audit log entry by ID"""
    return db.query(AuditLog).filter(AuditLog.id == log_id).first()


def log_login(db: Session, user_id: int, ip_address: str, user_agent: str) -> AuditLog:
    """Log a user login action"""
    return create_audit_log(
        db,
        user_id=user_id,
        action="login",
        description="User logged in",
        ip_address=ip_address,
        user_agent=user_agent,
    )


def log_logout(db: Session, user_id: int, ip_address: str, user_agent: str) -> AuditLog:
    """Log a user logout action"""
    return create_audit_log(
        db,
        user_id=user_id,
        action="logout",
        description="User logged out",
        ip_address=ip_address,
        user_agent=user_agent,
    )


def log_profile_update(db: Session, user_id: int, updated_fields: List[str]) -> AuditLog:
    """Log a profile update action"""
    return create_audit_log(
        db,
        user_id=user_id,
        action="profile_update",
        description="User updated profile",
        details=json.dumps({"updated_fields": updated_fields}),
    )


def log_password_change(db: Session, user_id: int) -> AuditLog:
    """Log a password change action"""
    return create_audit_log(
        db,
        user_id=user_id,
        action="password_change",
        description="User changed password",
    )

"""
Security middleware - Protection against common web attacks and API usage tracking
"""

from datetime import UTC, datetime

from fastapi import Request
from starlette.middleware.base import BaseHTTPMiddleware
from starlette.responses import Response
from typing import Callable
import time
import logging

from database.database import SessionLocal
from database.models import APIUsage
from config import PAGE_PREFIX_MAP


def _resolve_page(path: str) -> str:
    """Determine which logical page a request path belongs to."""
    for prefix, page in PAGE_PREFIX_MAP.items():
        if path.startswith(prefix):
            return page
    return "other"


class SecurityMiddleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware):
    """
    Middleware for:
    - Security headers
    - API usage tracking for dashboard statistics
    """

    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next: Callable) -> Response:
        start_time = time.time()

        response = await call_next(request)

        process_time = time.time() - start_time

        # Security headers
        response.headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff"
        response.headers["X-Frame-Options"] = "DENY"
        response.headers["X-XSS-Protection"] = "1; mode=block"
        response.headers["Strict-Transport-Security"] = "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains"

        # Track API usage for /api/* endpoints
        path = request.url.path
        if path.startswith("/api/"):
            try:
                db = SessionLocal()
                try:
                    usage = APIUsage(
                        endpoint=path,
                        method=request.method,
                        page=_resolve_page(path),
                        response_status=response.status_code,
                        response_time_ms=int(process_time * 1000),
                        timestamp=datetime.now(UTC).replace(tzinfo=None),
                    )
                    db.add(usage)
                    db.commit()
                finally:
                    db.close()
            except Exception:
                logging.exception("Failed to track API usage for path %s", path)

        return response

"""
Database bootstrap and data-access utilities.

This module centralizes:
- SQLAlchemy engine/session setup.
- Declarative base registration.
- Startup initialization for table creation.
- Optional demo-data seeding for dashboard-oriented tables.
- Read helpers used by API routes.

The functions in this file intentionally keep ORM interactions simple and
explicit so startup/runtime behavior remains predictable in local development.
"""

import os
from datetime import UTC, date, datetime, timedelta
from typing import Optional

from sqlalchemy import create_engine, event
from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

from config import DATABASE_URL

# Configure engine arguments based on database URL
_engine_kwargs = {}
if DATABASE_URL.startswith("sqlite"):
    _engine_kwargs = {"connect_args": {"check_same_thread": False}}

# Create database engine
engine = create_engine(DATABASE_URL, **_engine_kwargs)


@event.listens_for(Engine, "connect")
def _set_sqlite_pragma(dbapi_connection, connection_record):
    """Enable SQLite foreign-key enforcement per connection.

    SQLite does not enforce foreign keys by default. This event hook ensures
    relational constraints (for example user deletion effects) are honored.
    The hook is a no-op for non-SQLite backends.
    """
    if not DATABASE_URL.startswith("sqlite"):
        return
    cursor = dbapi_connection.cursor()
    cursor.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
    cursor.close()

# Create session factory
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(
    autocommit=False,
    autoflush=False,
    expire_on_commit=False,
    bind=engine,
)

# Create declarative base for models
Base = declarative_base()


def get_db():
    """
    Yield a request-scoped SQLAlchemy session.

    Yields:
        Session: Active SQLAlchemy session bound to ``engine``.

    Side Effects:
        Opens a DB session and guarantees closure in ``finally`` to avoid
        leaked connections.
    """
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()


_BOOL_TRUE_VALUES = {"1"}
_BOOL_FALSE_VALUES = {"0"}
_BOOL_VALID_VALUES = _BOOL_TRUE_VALUES | _BOOL_FALSE_VALUES


def _parse_bool_env(name: str, default: str) -> bool:
    """Return the boolean value of an environment variable using strict formatting.

    Accepted truthy value: ``"1"``.
    Accepted falsy value: ``"0"``.

    Args:
        name: Environment variable name.
        default: Fallback value used when the variable is not set. Must itself
            be one of the accepted values.

    Returns:
        bool: ``True`` when the resolved value is in the truthy set.

    Raises:
        ValueError: When the resolved value does not match any accepted value.
    """
    value = os.getenv(name, default)
    if value not in _BOOL_VALID_VALUES:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Environment variable '{name}' has invalid value {value!r}. "
            f"Accepted values are: {sorted(_BOOL_VALID_VALUES)}"
        )
    return value in _BOOL_TRUE_VALUES


def init_db():
    """
    Initialize database schema and optional seed data.

    Responsibilities:
    - Import ORM models so metadata is fully registered.
    - Create missing tables via ``Base.metadata.create_all``.
        - Preload a test user plus IDMS and API usage sample rows by default,
            with environment flags available for explicit opt-out.

    Notes:
        This is startup-oriented initialization for development and testing
        environments. Migration-based schema evolution should be used for
        long-lived production systems.

        Each ``PRELOAD_*`` environment variable must be set to a strict value:
        ``"1"`` (enable) or ``"0"`` (disable). Any other value raises a
        ``ValueError`` at startup.
    """
    from database.models import User, AuditLog, APIUsage, IDMSData, BlacklistedToken  # noqa: F401
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

    # Normalize legacy IDMS date strings persisted as datetimes in older DBs.
    normalize_legacy_idms_dates()

    if _parse_bool_env("PRELOAD_DUMMY_USERS", "1"):
        preload_dummy_user_data()

    # Default to preloading demo data on startup; allow explicit opt-out.
    if _parse_bool_env("PRELOAD_DUMMY_IDMS", "1"):
        preload_dummy_idms_data()

    # Optional bootstrap data for local/demo environments.
    if _parse_bool_env("PRELOAD_DUMMY_API_USAGE", "1"):
        preload_dummy_api_usage_data()


def normalize_legacy_idms_dates() -> int:
    """Normalize legacy ``idms_data.last_service_date`` values to ``YYYY-MM-DD``.

    Older local SQLite data may contain datetime-like strings (for example
    ``YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.ssssss``) while the ORM model expects ``Date``.
    SQLAlchemy then fails to parse these values during row hydration.

    Returns:
        int: Number of rows updated.
    """
    if not DATABASE_URL.startswith("sqlite"):
        return 0

    with engine.begin() as connection:
        table_exists = connection.execute(
            text("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='idms_data'")
        ).scalar()
        if not table_exists:
            return 0

        updated = connection.execute(
            text(
                """
                UPDATE idms_data
                SET last_service_date = substr(last_service_date, 1, 10)
                WHERE instr(last_service_date, ' ') > 0
                """
            )
        )
        return updated.rowcount or 0


def preload_dummy_user_data() -> int:
    """Insert a single test user account if it does not exist.

    Returns:
        int: Number of inserted rows. Returns ``0`` when user already exists.

    Failure Behavior:
        Rolls back the transaction and re-raises any database exception.
    """
    from passlib.context import CryptContext
    from database.models import User

    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        existing_user = db.query(User).filter(User.username == "testuser").first()
        if existing_user is not None:
            return 0

        # Seed-only local credential; stored as a one-way bcrypt hash.
        pwd_context = CryptContext(schemes=["bcrypt"], deprecated="auto")
        user = User(
            username="testuser",
            email="testuser@example.com",
            hashed_password=pwd_context.hash("password"),
            name="Test User",
            phone="555-0100",
        )

        db.add(user)
        db.commit()
        return 1
    except Exception:
        db.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        db.close()

    """Insert sample IDMS records if none exist.

    db = SessionLocal()
    try:

        samples = [

            IDMSData(asset_id="AST-1002", site="Houston", equipment_type="Conveyor", status="Maintenance", last_service_date=date(2026, 2, 2)),
            IDMSData(asset_id="AST-1003", site="Phoenix", equipment_type="Pump", status="Active", last_service_date=date(2025, 12, 20)),
            IDMSData(asset_id="AST-1004", site="Nashville", equipment_type="Boiler", status="Offline", last_service_date=date(2025, 11, 30)),
            IDMSData(asset_id="AST-1005", site="Cleveland", equipment_type="Generator", status="Active", last_service_date=date(2026, 2, 25)),
        ]

        db.add_all(samples)
        db.commit()
        return len(samples)
    except Exception:
        db.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        db.close()


def get_idms_data_read_only():
    """Fetch IDMS rows for dashboard display in stable asset order.

    Returns:
        list[IDMSData]: All IDMS records ordered by ``asset_id`` ascending.

    Side Effects:
        Opens and closes a short-lived read session. No writes are performed.
    """
    from database.models import IDMSData

    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        return db.query(IDMSData).order_by(IDMSData.asset_id.asc()).all()
    finally:

def preload_dummy_api_usage_data() -> int:
    """Insert sample API usage events if none exist.

    Returns:
        int: Number of inserted rows. Returns ``0`` when data already exists.

    Failure Behavior:
        Rolls back the transaction and re-raises any database exception.
    """
    from database.models import APIUsage

    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        existing_rows = db.query(APIUsage).count()
        if existing_rows > 0:
            return 0

        now = datetime.now(UTC).replace(tzinfo=None)
        samples = [
            APIUsage(endpoint="/api/health", method="GET", page="landing", user_id=None,
                     response_status=200, response_time_ms=24, timestamp=now - timedelta(days=3)),
            APIUsage(endpoint="/api/dashboard/api-usage", method="GET", page="dashboard", user_id=None,
                     response_status=200, response_time_ms=68, timestamp=now - timedelta(days=2, hours=4)),
            APIUsage(endpoint="/api/auth/login", method="POST", page="login", user_id=None,
                     response_status=200, response_time_ms=105, timestamp=now - timedelta(days=2, hours=1)),
            APIUsage(endpoint="/api/audit", method="GET", page="audit-log", user_id=None,
                     response_status=200, response_time_ms=41, timestamp=now - timedelta(days=1, hours=6)),
            APIUsage(endpoint="/api/settings/profile", method="PUT", page="settings", user_id=None,
                     response_status=200, response_time_ms=90, timestamp=now - timedelta(hours=12)),
            APIUsage(endpoint="/api/dashboard/api-usage/total", method="GET", page="dashboard", user_id=None,
                     response_status=200, response_time_ms=53, timestamp=now - timedelta(hours=2)),
        ]

        db.add_all(samples)
        db.commit()
        return len(samples)
    except Exception:
        db.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        db.close()


def get_api_usage_by_date_range(
    start_datetime: datetime,
    end_datetime: datetime,
    user_id: Optional[int] = None,
):
    """Query API usage rows in an inclusive timestamp window.

    Args:
        start_datetime: Lower bound (inclusive) for ``APIUsage.timestamp``.
        end_datetime: Upper bound (inclusive) for ``APIUsage.timestamp``.
        user_id: Optional user filter. When provided, only matching rows are
            returned.

    Returns:
        list[APIUsage]: Matching rows ordered by newest timestamp first.

    Side Effects:
        Opens/closes a session for read access only.
    """
    from database.models import APIUsage

    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        query = db.query(APIUsage).filter(
            APIUsage.timestamp >= start_datetime,
            APIUsage.timestamp <= end_datetime,
        )

        if user_id is not None:
            query = query.filter(APIUsage.user_id == user_id)

        return query.order_by(APIUsage.timestamp.desc()).all()
    finally:
        db.close()

"""
SQLAlchemy ORM models for core application data.

The models below define persistence contracts for authentication,
auditability, dashboard metrics, and dashboard asset data. Constraints and
indexes are declared at the model level to keep integrity and query behavior
close to the owning schema.
"""

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from sqlalchemy import (
    CheckConstraint,
    Column,
    Date,
    DateTime,
    ForeignKey,
    Index,
    Integer,
    String,
    Text,
)
from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship

from database.database import Base


def utcnow_naive() -> datetime:
    """Return a naive UTC datetime without using deprecated utcnow APIs."""
    return datetime.now(UTC).replace(tzinfo=None)


class User(Base):
    """Application user account record.

    Stores identity/contact attributes plus a password hash.
    ``hashed_password`` must always contain a one-way hash; plaintext password
    material must never be persisted.
    """
    __tablename__ = "users"
    __table_args__ = (
        CheckConstraint("length(username) >= 3", name="ck_users_username_min_len"),
        CheckConstraint("length(hashed_password) >= 20", name="ck_users_password_hash_min_len"),
    )

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    username = Column(String(50), unique=True, index=True, nullable=False)
    email = Column(String(100), unique=True, index=True, nullable=False)
    # Password hashes only (e.g., bcrypt); never store plaintext passwords.
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    name = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    phone = Column(String(20), nullable=True)
    profile_picture = Column(String(255), nullable=True)  # Filename of profile picture

    # Relationships
    audit_logs = relationship("AuditLog", back_populates="user", cascade="all, delete-orphan")

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"<User(id={self.id}, username='{self.username}')>"


class AuditLog(Base):
    """Immutable-style audit trail entry.

    Captures who performed an action, what action occurred, and supporting
    context such as user agent and IP metadata. Composite indexes optimize
    filtering by user and recency.
    """
    __tablename__ = "audit_logs"
    __table_args__ = (
        Index("ix_audit_logs_user_id", "user_id"),
        Index("ix_audit_logs_user_id_timestamp", "user_id", "timestamp"),
    )

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("users.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False)
    action = Column(String(50), nullable=False)  # login, logout, update, view, etc.
    description = Column(Text, nullable=True)
    details = Column(Text, nullable=True)  # JSON string for additional details
    ip_address = Column(String(45), nullable=True)
    user_agent = Column(String(255), nullable=True)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, default=utcnow_naive, index=True, nullable=False)

    # Relationships
    user = relationship("User", back_populates="audit_logs")

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"<AuditLog(id={self.id}, action='{self.action}', timestamp={self.timestamp})>"


class APIUsage(Base):
    """Request telemetry used for dashboard usage analytics.

    Rows represent endpoint-level API activity with optional response
    measurements. Check constraints bound accepted HTTP methods and keep metric
    fields in valid ranges.
    """
    __tablename__ = "api_usage"
    __table_args__ = (
        Index("ix_api_usage_user_id_timestamp", "user_id", "timestamp"),
        Index("ix_api_usage_page_timestamp", "page", "timestamp"),
        CheckConstraint("method IN ('GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE')", name="ck_api_usage_method"),
        CheckConstraint(
            "response_status IS NULL OR (response_status >= 100 AND response_status <= 599)",
            name="ck_api_usage_response_status",
        ),
        CheckConstraint(
            "response_time_ms IS NULL OR response_time_ms >= 0",
            name="ck_api_usage_response_time_non_negative",
        ),
    )

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    endpoint = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    method = Column(String(10), nullable=False)  # GET, POST, PUT, DELETE
    page = Column(String(50), nullable=False)  # Which page the API is for
    user_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("users.id", ondelete="SET NULL"), nullable=True)
    response_status = Column(Integer, nullable=True)
    response_time_ms = Column(Integer, nullable=True)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, default=utcnow_naive, index=True, nullable=False)

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"<APIUsage(id={self.id}, endpoint='{self.endpoint}', timestamp={self.timestamp})>"


class BlacklistedToken(Base):
    """Blacklisted JWT tokens (invalidated on logout)"""
    __tablename__ = "blacklisted_tokens"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    token = Column(String(500), unique=True, index=True, nullable=False)
    blacklisted_at = Column(DateTime, default=utcnow_naive)
    expires_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False)

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"<BlacklistedToken(id={self.id})>"


class IDMSData(Base):
    """Read-oriented asset dataset shown on the dashboard.

    The schema mirrors dashboard table columns and enforces a controlled
    ``status`` domain. ``asset_id`` is unique to prevent duplicate asset rows.
    """
    __tablename__ = "idms_data"

    __table_args__ = (
        CheckConstraint(
            "status IN ('Active', 'Maintenance', 'Offline', 'Retired')",
            name="ck_idms_data_status",
        ),
    )

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    asset_id = Column(String(100), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    site = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    equipment_type = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
    last_service_date = Column(Date, nullable=False, index=True)

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"<IDMSData(id={self.id})>"

async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):

)

from datetime import UTC, date, datetime
from tests.conftest import TestingSessionLocal
from database.models import IDMSData, APIUsage


def _seed_idms(n=3):
    """Insert sample IDMS rows."""
    session = TestingSessionLocal()
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        session.add(
            IDMSData(
                asset_id=f"AST-{1000 + i}",
                site=f"Site {i}",
                equipment_type="Pump",
                status="Active",
                last_service_date=date(2026, 1, min(i, 28)),
            )
        )
    session.commit()
    session.close()


def _seed_api_usage(pages=("auth", "dashboard", "settings"), count_each=2):
    session = TestingSessionLocal()
    for page in pages:
        for _ in range(count_each):
            session.add(APIUsage(
                endpoint=f"/api/{page}/test",
                method="GET",
                page=page,
                response_status=200,
                response_time_ms=10,

    session.commit()
    session.close()

toolSpecificData.prompt: Thoroughly review this repository's backend code for missing error handling or incomplete/missing code paths. Focus on user-auth flows, DB interactions, file uploads, and API routes. Look for unhandled exceptions, missing validation, risky assumptions, and places where code should return a controlled HTTP error but may crash. Return findings ordered by severity with file path and line number, concise explanation, and suggested fix. Also list any TODO/pass/placeholder stubs if present.
toolSpecificData.result:
Based on my thorough review of the backend code, I've identified multiple error handling and robustness issues. Here's my comprehensive report organized by severity:

## 🔴 **CRITICAL ISSUES**

### 1. **Unhandled File Write Failure in Profile Picture Upload**
- **File**: [routers/settings.py](routers/settings.py#L84-L90)
- **Lines**: 84-90
- **Issue**: File write operation has no error handling. If disk is full, permissions fail, or path is invalid, the app crashes with 500 error instead of controlled response.
- **Current Code**:
```python
with open(filepath, "wb") as f:
    f.write(contents)
```
- **Fix**: Wrap in try/except and return proper HTTPException(400/500):
```python
try:
    with open(filepath, "wb") as f:
        f.write(contents)
except (IOError, OSError) as e:
    raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Failed to save file")
```

### 2. **Silent Failures in API Usage Audit Logging**
- **File**: [middleware/security.py](middleware/security.py#L40-L53)
- **Lines**: 40-53
- **Issue**: Database errors in audit logging are caught but only logged via `logging.exception()`. Commits could fail silently, losing audit trail without API consumer knowing. Additionally, no proper error context bubbles up.
- **Current Code**: `except Exception: logging.exception(...)`
- **Fix**: Log with more context or re-raise after logging critical audits

### 3. **Database Commit Failures Unhandled in Audit Service**
- **File**: [services/audit_service.py](services/audit_service.py#L26-L34)
- **Lines**: 26-34, and all audit logging functions
- **Issue**: `db.commit()` can raise exceptions (constraint violations, connection loss, etc.) that are not caught. This can crash endpoints after partial state changes.
- **Current Code**:
```python
db.add(audit_log)
db.commit()  # Can throw!
```
- **Fix**: Wrap commit in try/except or use context managers with proper rollback

### 4. **Profile Picture Deletion Race Condition & Missing Error Handling**
- **File**: [routers/settings.py](routers/settings.py#L91-L95)
- **Lines**: 91-95
- **Issue**: TOCTOU vulnerability—file existence checked but deleted without atomicity. If file is deleted between check and removal, `os.remove()` throws uncaught `FileNotFoundError`, crashing the endpoint.
- **Fix**: Wrap in try/except block:
```python
if current_user.profile_picture:
    old_path = os.path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, current_user.profile_picture)
    try:
        if os.path.exists(old_path):
            os.remove(old_path)
    except (FileNotFoundError, OSError):
        pass  # File already gone or permission denied; continue
```

### 5. **Directory Creation Failure Not Caught**
- **File**: [routers/settings.py](routers/settings.py#L85)
- **Lines**: 85
- **Issue**: `os.makedirs(UPLOAD_DIR, exist_ok=True)` can fail (permission denied, path conflict) but raises exception uncaught, crashing with 500.
- **Fix**: Wrap in try/except:
```python
try:
    os.makedirs(UPLOAD_DIR, exist_ok=True)
except OSError as e:
    raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Upload directory unavailable")
```

---

## 🟠 **HIGH SEVERITY ISSUES**

### 6. **No Content Type Validation for File Uploads**
- **File**: [routers/settings.py](routers/settings.py#L68-L76)
- **Lines**: 68-76
- **Issue**: Only validates file extension by name, not actual content. A file named `exploit.png` could contain executable data, bypassing security. No magic number validation.
- **Fix**: Validate MIME type or file magic:
```python
# Read first bytes and check magic number (PNG: 89504E47, JPEG: FFD8FF)
file_bytes = await file.read()
await file.seek(0)  # Reset for saving
if ext == "png" and not file_bytes.startswith(b'\x89PNG'):
    raise HTTPException(400, "File content does not match PNG format")
```

### 7. **Missing Input Validation in Login Schema**
- **File**: [schemas/auth.py](schemas/auth.py#L7-L9)
- **Lines**: 7-9
- **Issue**: `LoginRequest` accepts empty strings for username/password (min_length constraint missing). Pydantic will accept `{"username": "", "password": ""}` and pass to auth logic.
- **Fix**:
```python
class LoginRequest(BaseModel):
    username: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    password: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
```

### 8. **Inconsistent Error Propagation in Settings Updates**
- **File**: [routers/settings.py](routers/settings.py#L29-L48)
- **Lines**: 29-48
- **Issue**: If `db.commit()` at line 39 fails (constraint violation, connection loss), the exception propagates as 500 instead of controlled 400. Also, `db.refresh()` after commit could fail if commit partially succeeded.
- **Fix**: Wrap in try/except to handle database errors:
```python
try:
    if updated_fields:
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(current_user)
except IntegrityError:
    raise HTTPException(400, "Update failed due to constraint violation")
except Exception:
    db.rollback()
    raise HTTPException(500, "Database error")
```

### 9. **Missing Error Handling for Token Blacklist Query in Refresh**
- **File**: [routers/auth.py](routers/auth.py#L79-L100) 
- **Lines**: 79-100
- **Issue**: Call to `is_token_blacklisted()` in line 81 could fail if database connection drops, but no try/catch. Exception propagates as 500.
- **Fix**: Wrap in try/except or move to verify_token logic with proper error handling

### 10. **Unsafe File Path Construction**
- **File**: [routers/settings.py](routers/settings.py#L86)
- **Lines**: 86
- **Issue**: While using `os.path.join()` is good, the `UPLOAD_DIR` is not validated against path traversal in edge cases. If `UPLOAD_DIR` is user-controllable, this could be exploited.
- **Note**: Currently safe since `UPLOAD_DIR` is from config, but document assumption.

---

## 🟡 **MEDIUM SEVERITY ISSUES**

### 11. **No Error Message Differentiation in Refresh Endpoint**
- **File**: [routers/auth.py](routers/auth.py#L93-L95)
- **Lines**: 93-95
- **Issue**: User lookup can fail for multiple reasons (deleted user, DB error) but same error message "Invalid token" returned. Doesn't help distinguish actual token invalidity vs. system errors.
- **Fix**: Log internal errors separately, return generic message to client

### 12. **Password Update Doesn't Validate Password Strength**
- **File**: [routers/settings.py](routers/settings.py#L56-L65)
- **Lines**: 56-65
- **Issue**: Only checks length (`len >= 8`). No complexity requirements (uppercase, numbers, special chars). Weak passwords can bypass application intent.
- **Note**: This may be intentional per requirements, but document if so.

### 13. **Audit Logging Bypassed on Profile Picture Deletion Failure**
- **File**: [routers/settings.py](routers/settings.py#L127-L135)
- **Lines**: 127-135
- **Issue**: If `db.commit()` fails at line 131, audit log at line 132 is never called. Update to DB half-succeeds without audit trail.
- **Fix**: Move audit log before commit or wrap both in transaction

### 14. **No Timeout on Large File Uploads**
- **File**: [routers/settings.py](routers/settings.py#L68-L76)
- **Lines**: 68-76
- **Issue**: `await file.read()` can hang indefinitely with slow/malicious clients. Max size check happens after full read, so slow uploads waste resources.
- **Fix**: Set FastAPI request size limits in main.py or validate size before read

### 15. **Audit Log Retrieval Missing Permission Checks on Details**
- **File**: [routers/audit_log.py](routers/audit_log.py#L33-L52)
- **Lines**: 33-52
- **Issue**: `get_audit_log_by_id()` only checks permission after fetching, and only for `/api/audit/{log_id}` endpoint. If log entry doesn't exist, 404 before permission check (info leak about existence).
- **Fix**: Check permission before querying or return 404 for both "not found" and "forbidden" cases

---

## 🔵 **LOW SEVERITY ISSUES**

### 16. **Phone Number Format Not Validated**
- **File**: [schemas/user.py](schemas/user.py#L5-L10)
- **Lines**: 5-10
- **Issue**: Phone field accepts any string up to large length. Should validate format or at least length constraints.
- **Fix**: Add regex pattern: `phone: Optional[str] = Field(None, pattern=r"^\d{1,20}$")`

### 17. **Missing Docstrings for Error Cases**
- **File**: Multiple routers ([routers/auth.py](routers/auth.py#L26), [routers/settings.py](routers/settings.py#L68))
- **Issue**: Endpoints document happy path but not all error responses (500, 503, etc.). Unclear what errors are expected.
- **Fix**: Add OpenAPI response models for errors

### 18. **Inefficient Duplicate Check in Settings Update**
- **File**: [routers/settings.py](routers/settings.py#L34-L41)
- **Lines**: 34-41
- **Issue**: Multiple DB queries for uniqueness checks. Could be combined or cached.
- **Note**: Low priority, but consider 2-3 queries per update.

### 19. **No IP Address Parsing Validation**
- **File**: [routers/auth.py](routers/auth.py#L45-L46)
- **Lines**: 45-46, [routers/auth.py](routers/auth.py#L69-L70)
- **Issue**: `request.client.host if request.client else "unknown"` could accept invalid IPs or None, stored as-is. No validation of IP format.
- **Fix**: Use ipaddress module to validate before storage

---

## 📝 **TODO/PLACEHOLDER STUBS FOUND**

**None found** in main backend code. The codebase is clean of TODO/FIXME/pass statements (matches grep results showing only dependencies had these).

---

## **SUMMARY TABLE**

| Severity | Count | Key Areas |
|----------|-------|-----------|
| 🔴 Critical | 5 | File I/O, Audit logging, Form validation |
| 🟠 High | 5 | Content validation, Error propagation, DB commits |
| 🟡 Medium | 5 | Error differentiation, Weak password rules, Audit gaps |
| 🔵 Low | 4 | Input format validation, Documentation, IP validation |

**Highest Risk Areas**: File upload handling, database transaction management, and audit logging failure modes. Recommend prioritizing fixes in order: 1→5→6→7→8.

Based on my thorough review of the backend code, I've identified multiple error handling and robustness issues. Here's my comprehensive report organized by severity:

## 🔴 **CRITICAL ISSUES**

### 1. **Unhandled File Write Failure in Profile Picture Upload**
- **File**: [routers/settings.py](routers/settings.py#L84-L90)
- **Lines**: 84-90
- **Issue**: File write operation has no error handling. If disk is full, permissions fail, or path is invalid, the app crashes with 500 error instead of controlled response.
- **Current Code**:
```python
with open(filepath, "wb") as f:
    f.write(contents)
```
- **Fix**: Wrap in try/except and return proper HTTPException(400/500):
```python
try:
    with open(filepath, "wb") as f:
        f.write(contents)
except (IOError, OSError) as e:
    raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Failed to save file")
```

### 2. **Silent Failures in API Usage Audit Logging**
- **File**: [middleware/security.py](middleware/security.py#L40-L53)
- **Lines**: 40-53
- **Issue**: Database errors in audit logging are caught but only logged via `logging.exception()`. Commits could fail silently, losing audit trail without API consumer knowing. Additionally, no proper error context bubbles up.
- **Current Code**: `except Exception: logging.exception(...)`
- **Fix**: Log with more context or re-raise after logging critical audits

### 3. **Database Commit Failures Unhandled in Audit Service**
- **File**: [services/audit_service.py](services/audit_service.py#L26-L34)
- **Lines**: 26-34, and all audit logging functions
- **Issue**: `db.commit()` can raise exceptions (constraint violations, connection loss, etc.) that are not caught. This can crash endpoints after partial state changes.
- **Current Code**:
```python
db.add(audit_log)
db.commit()  # Can throw!
```
- **Fix**: Wrap commit in try/except or use context managers with proper rollback

### 4. **Profile Picture Deletion Race Condition & Missing Error Handling**
- **File**: [routers/settings.py](routers/settings.py#L91-L95)
- **Lines**: 91-95
- **Issue**: TOCTOU vulnerability—file existence checked but deleted without atomicity. If file is deleted between check and removal, `os.remove()` throws uncaught `FileNotFoundError`, crashing the endpoint.
- **Fix**: Wrap in try/except block:
```python
if current_user.profile_picture:
    old_path = os.path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, current_user.profile_picture)
    try:
        if os.path.exists(old_path):
            os.remove(old_path)
    except (FileNotFoundError, OSError):
        pass  # File already gone or permission denied; continue
```

### 5. **Directory Creation Failure Not Caught**
- **File**: [routers/settings.py](routers/settings.py#L85)
- **Lines**: 85
- **Issue**: `os.makedirs(UPLOAD_DIR, exist_ok=True)` can fail (permission denied, path conflict) but raises exception uncaught, crashing with 500.
- **Fix**: Wrap in try/except:
```python
try:
    os.makedirs(UPLOAD_DIR, exist_ok=True)
except OSError as e:
    raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Upload directory unavailable")
```

---

## 🟠 **HIGH SEVERITY ISSUES**

### 6. **No Content Type Validation for File Uploads**
- **File**: [routers/settings.py](routers/settings.py#L68-L76)
- **Lines**: 68-76
- **Issue**: Only validates file extension by name, not actual content. A file named `exploit.png` could contain executable data, bypassing security. No magic number validation.
- **Fix**: Validate MIME type or file magic:
```python
# Read first bytes and check magic number (PNG: 89504E47, JPEG: FFD8FF)
file_bytes = await file.read()
await file.seek(0)  # Reset for saving
if ext == "png" and not file_bytes.startswith(b'\x89PNG'):
    raise HTTPException(400, "File content does not match PNG format")
```

### 7. **Missing Input Validation in Login Schema**
- **File**: [schemas/auth.py](schemas/auth.py#L7-L9)
- **Lines**: 7-9
- **Issue**: `LoginRequest` accepts empty strings for username/password (min_length constraint missing). Pydantic will accept `{"username": "", "password": ""}` and pass to auth logic.
- **Fix**:
```python
class LoginRequest(BaseModel):
    username: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    password: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
```

### 8. **Inconsistent Error Propagation in Settings Updates**
- **File**: [routers/settings.py](routers/settings.py#L29-L48)
- **Lines**: 29-48
- **Issue**: If `db.commit()` at line 39 fails (constraint violation, connection loss), the exception propagates as 500 instead of controlled 400. Also, `db.refresh()` after commit could fail if commit partially succeeded.
- **Fix**: Wrap in try/except to handle database errors:
```python
try:
    if updated_fields:
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(current_user)
except IntegrityError:
    raise HTTPException(400, "Update failed due to constraint violation")
except Exception:
    db.rollback()
    raise HTTPException(500, "Database error")
```

### 9. **Missing Error Handling for Token Blacklist Query in Refresh**
- **File**: [routers/auth.py](routers/auth.py#L79-L100) 
- **Lines**: 79-100
- **Issue**: Call to `is_token_blacklisted()` in line 81 could fail if database connection drops, but no try/catch. Exception propagates as 500.
- **Fix**: Wrap in try/except or move to verify_token logic with proper error handling

### 10. **Unsafe File Path Construction**
- **File**: [routers/settings.py](routers/settings.py#L86)
- **Lines**: 86
- **Issue**: While using `os.path.join()` is good, the `UPLOAD_DIR` is not validated against path traversal in edge cases. If `UPLOAD_DIR` is user-controllable, this could be exploited.
- **Note**: Currently safe since `UPLOAD_DIR` is from config, but document assumption.

---

## 🟡 **MEDIUM SEVERITY ISSUES**

### 11. **No Error Message Differentiation in Refresh Endpoint**
- **File**: [routers/auth.py](routers/auth.py#L93-L95)
- **Lines**: 93-95
- **Issue**: User lookup can fail for multiple reasons (deleted user, DB error) but same error message "Invalid token" returned. Doesn't help distinguish actual token invalidity vs. system errors.
- **Fix**: Log internal errors separately, return generic message to client

### 12. **Password Update Doesn't Validate Password Strength**
- **File**: [routers/settings.py](routers/settings.py#L56-L65)
- **Lines**: 56-65
- **Issue**: Only checks length (`len >= 8`). No complexity requirements (uppercase, numbers, special chars). Weak passwords can bypass application intent.
- **Note**: This may be intentional per requirements, but document if so.

### 13. **Audit Logging Bypassed on Profile Picture Deletion Failure**
- **File**: [routers/settings.py](routers/settings.py#L127-L135)
- **Lines**: 127-135
- **Issue**: If `db.commit()` fails at line 131, audit log at line 132 is never called. Update to DB half-succeeds without audit trail.
- **Fix**: Move audit log before commit or wrap both in transaction

### 14. **No Timeout on Large File Uploads**
- **File**: [routers/settings.py](routers/settings.py#L68-L76)
- **Lines**: 68-76
- **Issue**: `await file.read()` can hang indefinitely with slow/malicious clients. Max size check happens after full read, so slow uploads waste resources.
- **Fix**: Set FastAPI request size limits in main.py or validate size before read

### 15. **Audit Log Retrieval Missing Permission Checks on Details**
- **File**: [routers/audit_log.py](routers/audit_log.py#L33-L52)
- **Lines**: 33-52
- **Issue**: `get_audit_log_by_id()` only checks permission after fetching, and only for `/api/audit/{log_id}` endpoint. If log entry doesn't exist, 404 before permission check (info leak about existence).
- **Fix**: Check permission before querying or return 404 for both "not found" and "forbidden" cases

---

## 🔵 **LOW SEVERITY ISSUES**

### 16. **Phone Number Format Not Validated**
- **File**: [schemas/user.py](schemas/user.py#L5-L10)
- **Lines**: 5-10
- **Issue**: Phone field accepts any string up to large length. Should validate format or at least length constraints.
- **Fix**: Add regex pattern: `phone: Optional[str] = Field(None, pattern=r"^\d{1,20}$")`

### 17. **Missing Docstrings for Error Cases**
- **File**: Multiple routers ([routers/auth.py](routers/auth.py#L26), [routers/settings.py](routers/settings.py#L68))
- **Issue**: Endpoints document happy path but not all error responses (500, 503, etc.). Unclear what errors are expected.
- **Fix**: Add OpenAPI response models for errors

### 18. **Inefficient Duplicate Check in Settings Update**
- **File**: [routers/settings.py](routers/settings.py#L34-L41)
- **Lines**: 34-41
- **Issue**: Multiple DB queries for uniqueness checks. Could be combined or cached.
- **Note**: Low priority, but consider 2-3 queries per update.

### 19. **No IP Address Parsing Validation**
- **File**: [routers/auth.py](routers/auth.py#L45-L46)
- **Lines**: 45-46, [routers/auth.py](routers/auth.py#L69-L70)
- **Issue**: `request.client.host if request.client else "unknown"` could accept invalid IPs or None, stored as-is. No validation of IP format.
- **Fix**: Use ipaddress module to validate before storage

---

## 📝 **TODO/PLACEHOLDER STUBS FOUND**

**None found** in main backend code. The codebase is clean of TODO/FIXME/pass statements (matches grep results showing only dependencies had these).

---

## **SUMMARY TABLE**

| Severity | Count | Key Areas |
|----------|-------|-----------|
| 🔴 Critical | 5 | File I/O, Audit logging, Form validation |
| 🟠 High | 5 | Content validation, Error propagation, DB commits |
| 🟡 Medium | 5 | Error differentiation, Weak password rules, Audit gaps |
| 🔵 Low | 4 | Input format validation, Documentation, IP validation |

**Highest Risk Areas**: File upload handling, database transaction management, and audit logging failure modes. Recommend prioritizing fixes in order: 1→5→6→7→8.

"""
Configuration settings for the Michelin Capstone backend
"""

import os
import json
import secrets
from dotenv import load_dotenv

load_dotenv()

# Database Configuration
DATABASE_URL = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL", "sqlite:///./michelin_capstone.db")

# Debug Mode
DEBUG = os.getenv("DEBUG", "False").lower() in ("true", "1", "yes")

# JWT Configuration
SECRET_KEY = os.getenv("SECRET_KEY")
if not SECRET_KEY:
    # In debug or test environments, fall back to a temporary, process-local key
    # so that missing configuration does not break imports or local development.
    if DEBUG or os.getenv("PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST"):
        SECRET_KEY = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    else:
        raise RuntimeError("SECRET_KEY is not set. Add it to backend/.env")
ALGORITHM = "HS256"
ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES = 30

# CORS Configuration
_origins_env = os.getenv("ALLOWED_ORIGINS", None)
if _origins_env:
    try:
        ALLOWED_ORIGINS = json.loads(_origins_env)
    except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
        ALLOWED_ORIGINS = [o.strip() for o in _origins_env.split(",") if o.strip()]
else:
    ALLOWED_ORIGINS = [
        "http://localhost",
        "http://localhost:5173",
        "http://localhost:5500",
        "http://localhost:8080",
        "http://127.0.0.1",
        "http://127.0.0.1:5173",
        "http://127.0.0.1:5500",
        "http://127.0.0.1:8080",
    ]

# File Upload Configuration
UPLOAD_DIR = "uploads/profile_pictures"
MAX_FILE_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024  # 5MB
ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {"png", "jpg", "jpeg", "gif"}

# API Configuration

    "/api/auth": "auth",
    "/api/landing": "landing",

}

# Security Configuration
BCRYPT_ROUNDS = 12

/**
 * Settings JS - Settings page functionality
 */

var originalUserData = null;

function getSettingsElements() {
    return {
        form: document.getElementById('settings-form'),
        message: document.getElementById('settings-message'),
        uploadBtn: document.getElementById('upload-btn'),
        fileInput: document.getElementById('profile-picture'),
        preview: document.getElementById('profile-picture-preview'),
        name: document.getElementById('name'),
        username: document.getElementById('username'),
        email: document.getElementById('email'),
        phone: document.getElementById('phone'),
        currentPassword: document.getElementById('current-password'),
        newPassword: document.getElementById('new-password'),
        confirmPassword: document.getElementById('confirm-password')
    };
}

function toPublicUploadUrl(profilePicture) {
    if (!profilePicture) return '';
    if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(profilePicture)) return profilePicture;
    var apiBase = new URL(window.AppUtils.API_BASE_URL);
    return apiBase.origin + '/uploads/profile_pictures/' + profilePicture;
}

/**
 * Initialize settings page
 */
function initSettingsPage() {
    window.AppUtils.requireAuth();

    var els = getSettingsElements();
    if (!els.form) return;

    els.form.addEventListener('submit', handleSettingsSubmit);
    els.form.addEventListener('reset', handleFormReset);

    if (els.uploadBtn && els.fileInput) {
        els.uploadBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            els.fileInput.click();
        });
        els.fileInput.addEventListener('change', handleProfilePictureUpload);
    }

    loadUserSettings();
}

/**
 * Load current user settings
 */
async function loadUserSettings() {
    try {
        var user = await window.AppUtils.apiRequest('/settings/');
        originalUserData = user;
        populateSettingsForm(user);
    } catch (error) {
        displaySettingsMessage(error.message || 'Failed to load settings.', 'error');
    }
}

/**
 * Populate settings form with user data
 * @param {object} userData - User data
 */
function populateSettingsForm(userData) {
    var els = getSettingsElements();
    if (!userData || !els.form) return;

    if (els.name) els.name.value = userData.name || '';
    if (els.username) els.username.value = userData.username || '';
    if (els.email) els.email.value = userData.email || '';
    if (els.phone) els.phone.value = userData.phone || '';

    var imageUrl = toPublicUploadUrl(userData.profile_picture);
    if (els.preview) {
        els.preview.src = imageUrl || '';
    }

    if (imageUrl && window.Navigation && typeof window.Navigation.updateProfileIcon === 'function') {
        window.Navigation.updateProfileIcon(imageUrl);
    }
}

/**
 * Handle settings form submission
 * @param {Event} event - Form submit event
 */
async function handleSettingsSubmit(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    var formValidation = validateSettingsForm();
    if (!formValidation.isValid) {
        displaySettingsMessage(formValidation.errors[0], 'error');
        return;
    }

    var passwordValidation = validatePasswordChange();
    if (!passwordValidation.isValid) {
        displaySettingsMessage(passwordValidation.errors[0], 'error');
        return;
    }

    var els = getSettingsElements();
    var saveBtn = els.form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
    if (saveBtn) {
        saveBtn.disabled = true;
        saveBtn.textContent = 'Saving...';
    }

    try {
        var payload = {
            name: els.name.value.trim(),
            username: els.username.value.trim(),
            email: els.email.value.trim(),
            phone: els.phone.value.trim() || null
        };
        var updatedUser = await window.AppUtils.apiRequest('/settings/', {
            method: 'PUT',
            body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });

        var hasPasswordChange = !!(els.currentPassword.value || els.newPassword.value || els.confirmPassword.value);
        if (hasPasswordChange) {
            await window.AppUtils.apiRequest('/settings/password', {
                method: 'PUT',
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    current_password: els.currentPassword.value,
                    new_password: els.newPassword.value,
                    confirm_password: els.confirmPassword.value
                })
            });
        }

        originalUserData = updatedUser;
        populateSettingsForm(updatedUser);
        if (els.currentPassword) els.currentPassword.value = '';
        if (els.newPassword) els.newPassword.value = '';
        if (els.confirmPassword) els.confirmPassword.value = '';
        displaySettingsMessage('Settings updated successfully.', 'success');
    } catch (error) {
        displaySettingsMessage(error.message || 'Failed to update settings.', 'error');
    } finally {
        if (saveBtn) {
            saveBtn.disabled = false;
            saveBtn.textContent = 'Save Changes';
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Validate settings form
 * @returns {object} - Validation result with isValid and errors
 */
function validateSettingsForm() {
    var els = getSettingsElements();
    var errors = [];

    if (!els.name.value.trim()) errors.push('Name is required.');
    if (!els.username.value.trim()) errors.push('Username is required.');
    if (!els.email.value.trim()) errors.push('Email is required.');

    return {
        isValid: errors.length === 0,
        errors: errors
    };
}

/**
 * Validate password change fields
 * @returns {object} - Validation result for password fields
 */
function validatePasswordChange() {
    var els = getSettingsElements();
    var errors = [];
    var currentPassword = els.currentPassword.value;
    var newPassword = els.newPassword.value;
    var confirmPassword = els.confirmPassword.value;
    var hasAny = !!(currentPassword || newPassword || confirmPassword);

    if (!hasAny) {
        return { isValid: true, errors: [] };
    }

    if (!currentPassword) errors.push('Current password is required to change password.');
    if (!newPassword) errors.push('New password is required.');
    if (newPassword && newPassword.length < 8) errors.push('New password must be at least 8 characters.');
    if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) errors.push('New passwords do not match.');

    return {
        isValid: errors.length === 0,
        errors: errors
    };
}

/**
 * Handle profile picture upload
 * @param {Event} event - File input change event
 */
async function handleProfilePictureUpload(event) {
    var file = event && event.target && event.target.files ? event.target.files[0] : null;
    if (!file) return;

    previewProfilePicture(file);
    try {
        var userData = await uploadProfilePicture(file);
        if (userData) {
            originalUserData = userData;
            populateSettingsForm(userData);
        }
        displaySettingsMessage('Profile picture updated.', 'success');
    } catch (error) {
        displaySettingsMessage(error.message || 'Failed to upload picture.', 'error');
        if (originalUserData) {
            populateSettingsForm(originalUserData);
        }
    } finally {
        if (event && event.target) {
            event.target.value = '';
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Upload profile picture to server
 * @param {File} file - Image file to upload
 * @returns {Promise<string>} - Uploaded file path
 */
async function uploadProfilePicture(file) {
    var formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('file', file);

    var result = await window.AppUtils.apiRequest('/settings/profile-picture', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: formData
    });
    return result;
}

/**
 * Preview selected profile picture
 * @param {File} file - Selected image file
 */
function previewProfilePicture(file) {
    if (!file) return;
    var els = getSettingsElements();
    if (!els.preview) return;
    var reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function(e) {
        els.preview.src = e.target.result;
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
}

/**
 * Display settings update message
 * @param {string} message - Message to display
 * @param {string} type - Message type (success/error)
 */
function displaySettingsMessage(message, type) {
    var els = getSettingsElements();
    if (!els.message) return;
    els.message.textContent = message;
    els.message.className = 'form-message';
    if (type === 'success') {
        els.message.classList.add('success');
    } else {
        els.message.classList.add('form-error');
    }
    els.message.classList.add('show');
}

/**
 * Handle form reset
 * @param {Event} event - Reset event
 */
function handleFormReset(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!originalUserData) return;
    populateSettingsForm(originalUserData);

    var els = getSettingsElements();
    if (els.currentPassword) els.currentPassword.value = '';
    if (els.newPassword) els.newPassword.value = '';
    if (els.confirmPassword) els.confirmPassword.value = '';
    if (els.message) {
        els.message.textContent = '';
        els.message.className = 'form-message';
    }
}

// Initialize on DOM load
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    initSettingsPage();
});

/**
 * Settings JS - Settings page functionality
 */

var originalUserData = null;

function getSettingsElements() {
    return {
        form: document.getElementById('settings-form'),
        message: document.getElementById('settings-message'),
        uploadBtn: document.getElementById('upload-btn'),
        fileInput: document.getElementById('profile-picture'),
        preview: document.getElementById('profile-picture-preview'),
        name: document.getElementById('name'),
        username: document.getElementById('username'),
        email: document.getElementById('email'),
        phone: document.getElementById('phone'),
        currentPassword: document.getElementById('current-password'),
        newPassword: document.getElementById('new-password'),
        confirmPassword: document.getElementById('confirm-password')
    };
}

function toPublicUploadUrl(profilePicture) {
    if (!profilePicture) return '';
    if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(profilePicture)) return profilePicture;
    var apiBase = new URL(window.AppUtils.API_BASE_URL);
    return apiBase.origin + '/uploads/profile_pictures/' + profilePicture;
}

/**
 * Initialize settings page
 */
function initSettingsPage() {
    window.AppUtils.requireAuth();

    var els = getSettingsElements();
    if (!els.form) return;

    els.form.addEventListener('submit', handleSettingsSubmit);
    els.form.addEventListener('reset', handleFormReset);

    if (els.uploadBtn && els.fileInput) {
        els.uploadBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            els.fileInput.click();
        });
        els.fileInput.addEventListener('change', handleProfilePictureUpload);
    }

    loadUserSettings();
}

/**
 * Load current user settings
 */
async function loadUserSettings() {
    try {
        var user = await window.AppUtils.apiRequest('/settings/');
        originalUserData = user;
        populateSettingsForm(user);
    } catch (error) {
        displaySettingsMessage(error.message || 'Failed to load settings.', 'error');
    }
}

/**
 * Populate settings form with user data
 * @param {object} userData - User data
 */
function populateSettingsForm(userData) {
    var els = getSettingsElements();
    if (!userData || !els.form) return;

    if (els.name) els.name.value = userData.name || '';
    if (els.username) els.username.value = userData.username || '';
    if (els.email) els.email.value = userData.email || '';
    if (els.phone) els.phone.value = userData.phone || '';

    var imageUrl = toPublicUploadUrl(userData.profile_picture);
    if (els.preview) {
        els.preview.src = imageUrl || '';
    }

    if (imageUrl && window.Navigation && typeof window.Navigation.updateProfileIcon === 'function') {
        window.Navigation.updateProfileIcon(imageUrl);
    }
}

/**
 * Handle settings form submission
 * @param {Event} event - Form submit event
 */
async function handleSettingsSubmit(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    var formValidation = validateSettingsForm();
    if (!formValidation.isValid) {
        displaySettingsMessage(formValidation.errors[0], 'error');
        return;
    }

    var passwordValidation = validatePasswordChange();
    if (!passwordValidation.isValid) {
        displaySettingsMessage(passwordValidation.errors[0], 'error');
        return;
    }

    var els = getSettingsElements();
    var saveBtn = els.form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
    if (saveBtn) {
        saveBtn.disabled = true;
        saveBtn.textContent = 'Saving...';
    }

    try {
        var payload = {
            name: els.name.value.trim(),
            username: els.username.value.trim(),
            email: els.email.value.trim(),
            phone: els.phone.value.trim() || null
        };
        var updatedUser = await window.AppUtils.apiRequest('/settings/', {
            method: 'PUT',
            body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });

        var hasPasswordChange = !!(els.currentPassword.value || els.newPassword.value || els.confirmPassword.value);
        if (hasPasswordChange) {
            await window.AppUtils.apiRequest('/settings/password', {
                method: 'PUT',
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    current_password: els.currentPassword.value,
                    new_password: els.newPassword.value,
                    confirm_password: els.confirmPassword.value
                })
            });
        }

        originalUserData = updatedUser;
        populateSettingsForm(updatedUser);
        if (els.currentPassword) els.currentPassword.value = '';
        if (els.newPassword) els.newPassword.value = '';
        if (els.confirmPassword) els.confirmPassword.value = '';
        displaySettingsMessage('Settings updated successfully.', 'success');
    } catch (error) {
        displaySettingsMessage(error.message || 'Failed to update settings.', 'error');
    } finally {
        if (saveBtn) {
            saveBtn.disabled = false;
            saveBtn.textContent = 'Save Changes';
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Validate settings form
 * @returns {object} - Validation result with isValid and errors
 */
function validateSettingsForm() {
    var els = getSettingsElements();
    var errors = [];

    if (!els.name.value.trim()) errors.push('Name is required.');
    if (!els.username.value.trim()) errors.push('Username is required.');
    if (!els.email.value.trim()) errors.push('Email is required.');

    return {
        isValid: errors.length === 0,
        errors: errors
    };
}

/**
 * Validate password change fields
 * @returns {object} - Validation result for password fields
 */
function validatePasswordChange() {
    var els = getSettingsElements();
    var errors = [];
    var currentPassword = els.currentPassword.value;
    var newPassword = els.newPassword.value;
    var confirmPassword = els.confirmPassword.value;
    var hasAny = !!(currentPassword || newPassword || confirmPassword);

    if (!hasAny) {
        return { isValid: true, errors: [] };
    }

    if (!currentPassword) errors.push('Current password is required to change password.');
    if (!newPassword) errors.push('New password is required.');
    if (newPassword && newPassword.length < 8) errors.push('New password must be at least 8 characters.');
    if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) errors.push('New passwords do not match.');

    return {
        isValid: errors.length === 0,
        errors: errors
    };
}

/**
 * Handle profile picture upload
 * @param {Event} event - File input change event
 */
async function handleProfilePictureUpload(event) {
    var file = event && event.target && event.target.files ? event.target.files[0] : null;
    if (!file) return;

    previewProfilePicture(file);
    try {
        var userData = await uploadProfilePicture(file);
        if (userData) {
            originalUserData = userData;
            populateSettingsForm(userData);
        }
        displaySettingsMessage('Profile picture updated.', 'success');
    } catch (error) {
        displaySettingsMessage(error.message || 'Failed to upload picture.', 'error');
        if (originalUserData) {
            populateSettingsForm(originalUserData);
        }
    } finally {
        if (event && event.target) {
            event.target.value = '';
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Upload profile picture to server
 * @param {File} file - Image file to upload
 * @returns {Promise<string>} - Uploaded file path
 */
async function uploadProfilePicture(file) {
    var formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('file', file);

    var result = await window.AppUtils.apiRequest('/settings/profile-picture', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: formData
    });
    return result;
}

/**
 * Preview selected profile picture
 * @param {File} file - Selected image file
 */
function previewProfilePicture(file) {
    if (!file) return;
    var els = getSettingsElements();
    if (!els.preview) return;
    var reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function(e) {
        els.preview.src = e.target.result;
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
}

/**
 * Display settings update message
 * @param {string} message - Message to display
 * @param {string} type - Message type (success/error)
 */
function displaySettingsMessage(message, type) {
    var els = getSettingsElements();
    if (!els.message) return;
    els.message.textContent = message;
    els.message.className = 'form-message';
    if (type === 'success') {
        els.message.classList.add('success');
    } else {
        els.message.classList.add('form-error');
    }
    els.message.classList.add('show');
}

/**
 * Handle form reset
 * @param {Event} event - Reset event
 */
function handleFormReset(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!originalUserData) return;
    populateSettingsForm(originalUserData);

    var els = getSettingsElements();
    if (els.currentPassword) els.currentPassword.value = '';
    if (els.newPassword) els.newPassword.value = '';
    if (els.confirmPassword) els.confirmPassword.value = '';
    if (els.message) {
        els.message.textContent = '';
        els.message.className = 'form-message';
    }
}

// Initialize on DOM load
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    initSettingsPage();
});

 */

var originalUserData = null;

function getSettingsElements() {
    return {
        form: document.getElementById('settings-form'),
        message: document.getElementById('settings-message'),
        uploadBtn: document.getElementById('upload-btn'),

        newPassword: document.getElementById('new-password'),
        confirmPassword: document.getElementById('confirm-password')
    };
}

function toPublicUploadUrl(profilePicture) {
    if (!profilePicture) return '';
    if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(profilePicture)) return profilePicture;
    var apiBase = new URL(window.AppUtils.API_BASE_URL);
    return apiBase.origin + '/uploads/profile_pictures/' + profilePicture;
}

/**
 * Initialize settings page
 */
function initSettingsPage() {
    window.AppUtils.requireAuth();

    var els = getSettingsElements();
    if (!els.form) return;

    els.form.addEventListener('submit', handleSettingsSubmit);
    els.form.addEventListener('reset', handleFormReset);

    if (els.uploadBtn && els.fileInput) {
        els.uploadBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            els.fileInput.click();
        });
        els.fileInput.addEventListener('change', handleProfilePictureUpload);
    }

    loadUserSettings();
}

/**
 * Load current user settings
 */
async function loadUserSettings() {
    try {
        var user = await window.AppUtils.apiRequest('/settings/');
        originalUserData = user;
        populateSettingsForm(user);
    } catch (error) {
        displaySettingsMessage(error.message || 'Failed to load settings.', 'error');
    }
}

/**
 * Populate settings form with user data
 * @param {object} userData - User data
 */
function populateSettingsForm(userData) {
    var els = getSettingsElements();
    if (!userData || !els.form) return;

    if (els.name) els.name.value = userData.name || '';
    if (els.username) els.username.value = userData.username || '';
    if (els.email) els.email.value = userData.email || '';
    if (els.phone) els.phone.value = userData.phone || '';

    var imageUrl = toPublicUploadUrl(userData.profile_picture);
    if (els.preview) {
        els.preview.src = imageUrl || '';
    }

    if (imageUrl && window.Navigation && typeof window.Navigation.updateProfileIcon === 'function') {
        window.Navigation.updateProfileIcon(imageUrl);
    }
}

/**
 * Handle settings form submission
 * @param {Event} event - Form submit event
 */
async function handleSettingsSubmit(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    var formValidation = validateSettingsForm();
    if (!formValidation.isValid) {
        displaySettingsMessage(formValidation.errors[0], 'error');
        return;
    }

    var passwordValidation = validatePasswordChange();
    if (!passwordValidation.isValid) {
        displaySettingsMessage(passwordValidation.errors[0], 'error');
        return;
    }

    var els = getSettingsElements();

    if (saveBtn) {
        saveBtn.disabled = true;
        saveBtn.textContent = 'Saving...';
    }

    try {

            username: els.username.value.trim(),
            email: els.email.value.trim(),
            phone: els.phone.value.trim() || null
        };

            method: 'PUT',

        });

                })
            });

        originalUserData = updatedUser;

        if (els.currentPassword) els.currentPassword.value = '';
        if (els.newPassword) els.newPassword.value = '';
        if (els.confirmPassword) els.confirmPassword.value = '';

    } finally {
